wikipediaRead.title: Geba (city)
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事はゲバを聖書の古代都市とし、2 Chronicles 16:6でアサがラマから運んだ資材で築いた町と説明します。ジェバ比定は記事上の提案です。

primaryWitnesses.text: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 2 Chronicles 16:6はゲバを明記。WikipediaはGebaとGibeah/Gibeonを区別し、記事本文に2 Chronicles 16:6とジェバ比定を記載。現代同定は独立考古学的照合を行っていないため座標null。

reviewBasisJa: アサ王はユダの人々とともに、バアシャがラマの建設に用いた石と木を運び、それを使ってゲバとミツパを築きます。
